description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kerby Joseph is not expected to be ready for the Lions season opener.
items.impact: Joseph has been battling a knee injury since last year's training camp and missed 11 games last season. It is unclear if he'll begin the season on the PUP list.
items.title: Kerby Joseph (knee) not expected to be ready for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jordyn Tyson fully participated in all 11-on-11 and 7-on-7 drills on the first day of Saints training camp on Wednesday.
items.impact: Tyson missed time earlier in the Saints offseason program with a hamstring injury. It is a positive sign he was able to fully practice to begin training camp.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson fully practices Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chris Olave was limited to individual drills in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Saints coach Kellen Moore said it's "respecting the business side" of things, understanding that Olave is negotiating a long-term extension with the team. His new deal will continue to be worth monitoring.
items.title: Chris Olave only participates in individual drills Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said WR Chris Brazzell will get imaging.
items.impact: Brazzell re-aggravated the same knee injury he was dealing with earlier in the week. There should be an update on his status later in the week.
items.title: Chris Brazzell II (knee) to undergo imaging

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Shemar Stewart was taken back to the locker room during practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Walker appeared to get hurt during a team drill. There will be an update provided on his status when available.
items.title: Shemar Stewart leaves practice early Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alvin Kamara and Travis Etienne Jr. split first-team reps in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kamara reworked his contract earlier in July to return to the Saints. It is unclear what role he'll hold as Etienne likely leads the backfield. Kamara will figure to handle the passing downs.
items.title: Alvin Kamara splits first-team reps with Travis Etienne Jr. Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. split first-team reps with Alvin Kamara in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Etienne is likely to be the 1A in the Saints backfield with the contract he got in free agency. This will be a situation to monitor throughout training camp.
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. splits first-team reps with Alvin Kamara Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Nnamdi Madubuike was activated from the PUP list and back at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Madubuike was out on the field for his first practice in 10 months. He missed the last 15 games last season with a neck injury and underwent neck surgery in April.
items.title: Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) returns to practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Aaron Rodgers will have his reps limited this week.
items.impact: McCarthy added that means Rodgers will get 40-50 percent of the reps this week. The rest will be distributed among Mason Rudolph, Will Howard and Drew Allar.
items.title: Aaron Rodgers to have reps limited this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Javon Hargrave is not expected to be dealing with a long-term injury.
items.impact: Hargrave was placed on the PUP list to open training camp. Packers coach Matt LaFleur said it was because he showed up with something.
items.title: Javon Hargrave not dealing with long-term concern

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Patrick Mahomes II took reps in 11-on-11 drills at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: This is a notable sign as Mahomes remains hopeful to be ready for Week 1. His status will need to continue to be monitored, but he appears to be on track to be ready for the start of the season as of now.
items.title: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) takes 11-on-11 reps Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd is expected to be ramped up early in training camp.
items.impact: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Lloyd doesn't necessarily have a rep count in camp, but learning from past the plan is to "gradually" ramp him up for season. He'll compete for the backup role in training camp.
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd to be ramped up in training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said TE Luke Musgrave is dealing with a neck injury.
items.impact: LaFleur said Musgrave's neck injury goes back to the mandatory minicamp. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.
items.title: Luke Musgrave on PUP list with neck injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Vita Vea is dealing with a tweaked back.
items.impact: Vea had just requested a trade on Tuesday. He won't be rushed back into practice.
items.title: Vita Vea dealing with tweaked back

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. said it may be "another four weeks" before he is cleared to start practicing, but is hopeful it is sooner.
items.impact: A four week timeline puts Penix returning right before the Week 1, and gives plenty of time for Tua Tagovailoa to build rapport with the starters. It's looking likely that Penix will begin the year as the primary backup QB.
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. likely out 'another four weeks'

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mitchell Trubisky had some tightness during conditioning on Tuesday.
items.impact: Trubisky is considered day-to-day. He is competing in training camp with Will Levis for the backup role.
items.title: Mitchell Trubisky not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Calvin Ridley is not practicing on Wednesday due to a stomach bug.
items.impact: Ridley is expected to be back at practice on Thursday. He is day-to-day.
items.title: Calvin Ridley (illness) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Tristan Wirfs tweaked a hamstring in the running test Tuesday.
items.impact: Wirfs will miss some time as a result as he recovers. The Bucs won't rush him back.
items.title: Tristan Wirfs dealing with tweaked hamstring

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans waived TE Louis Hansen.
items.impact: Hansen will figure to seek another opportunity heading into training camp.
items.title: Louis Hansen waived by Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed WR DJ Turner.
items.impact: Turner spent the last four seasons with the Raiders where he appeared in 32 games. He'll compete for a depth role in the Texans wide receiver room.
items.title: DJ Turner signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. was back on the field in practice to begin training camp.
items.impact: Rodriguez missed time earlier in the Jaguars offseason program with a foot injury. He will be competing for an immediate role alongside Bhayshul Tuten.
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (foot) back at practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Josh Jacobs will be practicing on Wednesday as nothing has changed with his legal situation.
items.impact: The Packers are letting the legal decisions with Jacobs case play out. This will remain a situation to monitor throughout training camp.
items.title: Josh Jacobs: No change with legal situation, will practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sam LaPorta told reporters he is a full-go heading into training camp.
items.impact: It was announced last week that LaPorta was fully cleared. He has worked his way back to full health over the past 3-4 months. He will be in pads in practice.
items.title: Sam LaPorta (back) full-go for training camp

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Packers GM Brian Gutekunst says it's "very much a possibility" Tucker Kraft will be available Week 1.
items.impact: Kraft is 8.5 months removed from surgery. He is expected to be activated from the PUP list "sooner rather than later." He is also expected to work on an extension with Green Bay.
items.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) remains hopeful for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers activated OL Aaron Banks from the PUP list.
items.impact: Banks will return to practice on Wednesday.
items.title: Aaron Banks activated from PUP list

title: Fantasy Player News
